title: Haze: does Superior Duration stretch the smoke lifesteal window and item actives?
question: Superior Duration (+28% duration of abilities and items, +8% bullet resist, 3.2k) as an unconventional replacement for Healing Tempo: does it extend Smoke T3's 5 s lifesteal (PostInvisBuffDuration scales with ETechDuration in abilities.vdata), Vampiric Burst's 5 s and Burst Fire's 4.5 s?
hypothesis: If item durations stretch: smoke window 6.4 s, VB 6.4 s; model: replacing Healing Tempo with Superior Duration gives +762 damage in 20 s, +246 HP, and saves 3.2k souls. Prediction: heal time after cast 2 rises from ~5.0 s to >=6.2 s.

arms.name: superior_duration
arms.notes: non-imbue item: no imbue op needed

controls: hardreset between blocks (fresh pawns, factory cooldowns/charges, unlock 7 = all 3 tiers on every ability in BOTH arms)
Same position (fetch 350, aimoff 5.5 3), same enemy bot (Haze), egod default floor
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B (counterbalanced A,B,B,A for the second half)
healreset + mark none around every reset
cast reload 2.5 before each fire block (no auto-reload op)
fire in 1 s blocks with marks t1..t8 after cast 2 so heal per second is visible
procedure: give; lowhp 40; cast reload 2.5; cast 2 0.3; mark w1; fire 1; mark w2; fire 1; ... mark w8; fire 1 (reload between if needed: cast reload 2.5 is a 2.5 s gap, keep it identical in both arms)
healsum per mark; mods at each mark (smoke lifesteal buff name)
second block: give upgrade_surging_power; cast i1; same per-second marks for VB

metrics.name: smoke_lifesteal_window_s
metrics.how: last 1 s mark with heal/damage > 0.4 (or smoke buff modifier present in mods)

decision.rule: SUPPORTS Superior Duration as Healing Tempo's replacement candidate (then run haze_tempo_trigger result + this together) if the window is >=20% longer; REFUTES if unchanged.

limitations: Checkpoint level/ability-tier states cannot be reproduced (unlock sets all tiers; GAPS #2): results are late-game relative comparisons only.
Duration Extender (imbue) cannot be tested: no imbue op (GAPS #1).
